bounded_question: Can a materially different whole-surface representation logic survive two distinct neutral human-relational probes, remain independent of the current provisional family and historical surfaces, and establish one genuinely distinct second visual family?

authority.current_state_at_close: Frozen VFD-01 program-result commit 502c5fafb07ff9e8060c9d8223d26878da04cb01; packetization follows without changing that result.

controlled_inputs: four frozen pairwise-distant representation premises P1-P4
one frozen primary neutral human-relational content packet
one frozen materially different transfer neutral content packet
fresh non-project renderer context per probe
maximum four primary plus two transfer images with no reroll
excluded_variables: current C0/O3/TYP/MAT/STA/MOT/CLR mechanisms as construction seeds
historical exact VID/hero/Quiet Stage/Mineral Theater surfaces
color as a candidate identity axis
brand marks, wordmark, bespoke typography, product UI, semantic iconography

local_result.summary: P1-P3 failed their frozen primary gates. P4 Rule-Bearing Mosaic Field passed every primary gate and preserved its mosaic substrate in transfer, but the single transfer repeated too much of the primary causal staging/signature topology and therefore failed the conjunctive anti-copy/independent-transfer gate. VFD-01 closes with zero family survivors after 5 judgeable images.
alternates: P4 Rule-Bearing Mosaic Field is preserved as positive representation-mechanism evidence only; it is not a surviving family or incumbent.
rejections: P1 Accumulated Mark Field - ordinary figurative scene under impasto; historical painterly contamination
P2 Interlocking Plane Field - generic flat-vector/current-family geometric collapse
P3 Diffused Density Continuum - conventional atmospheric overlay and weak causal legibility
P4 transfer - mosaic grammar repeats, but primary barrier/worker/standing-person causal topology and signature motif repeat too closely

judgment.design_sol_view: The P4 mechanism is the strongest positive evidence from VFD-01 because its discrete-unit rule genuinely governs the whole surface and stays distant from the current provisional family. Under the frozen transfer law, however, repeatability of rendering grammar is insufficient when the second probe reuses the primary causal staging/signature motif; no family survivor can be claimed.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: The Director explicitly authorized Path 2 / bounded second-family exploration before VFD-01 construction. No post-result Director taste input was used in primary or transfer scoring; closure follows the frozen method under standing clean-recursive-audit delegation.

mechanical: P1-P4 primary supplied-byte hashes/dimensions frozen in VFD_01_PRIMARY_EVALUATION_01.json
image budget consumed 5/6; remaining slot expires by termination law
accessibility: Essential P4 relation/identity evidence survived through value, silhouette, unit-density and large-scale boundary organization without dependence on hue, text or motion.

requires: fresh post-VFD Phase-B sequencing/reentry audit before any successor program
constrains: future second-family programs must address P4 anti-copy/content-topology weakness if they cite mosaic evidence

known_integration_sensitivities: P4 proves a repeatable unit-based surface substrate but not transfer independence from barrier/worker relational staging.
Any future use of P4 evidence must distinguish the representation law from the failed primary/transfer scene topology.
The current provisional C0/O3/TYP/MAT/STA/MOT stack remains one provisional family/control and is not superseded by VFD-01.
explicit_non_authority: No second-family survivor, final family selection, final identity, production asset, app/site implementation, final palette/type/wordmark/iconography, whole-app synthesis or Phase-C convergence.
No P4 reroll, second transfer, premise repair/replacement or VFD-01 continuation.

director_review_surface.what_to_review: P4 primary and P4 transfer side-by-side if reviewing why the mosaic grammar repeats but the transfer-independent scene topology fails; P1-P3 remain useful failure evidence.
